text:
Olivia: Aequor Health just escalated a FedRAMP + data residency question. They want a hands-on sandbox walkthrough and compliance Q&A, ideally today. Can we rearrange the 4pm office hour?
Chen: I can lead the demo but need a security SME for the Q&A. Izzy available?
Izzy: I can take Q&A for 10-15m. Prefer morning PT.
Mateo: I'm on deck to scrub the dataset and snapshot the sandbox. Give me 30m. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sandbox-scrub
Olivia: They suggested two windows in their note: 09:30 or 11:00 PT. Which works for our team?
Riley: 11:00 PT is safest for coverage across EMEA/APAC.
Chen: 11:00 works for me. Izzy ok?
Izzy: Yes 11:00I can join 10:30 for pre-call sync.
Olivia: @cs_scheduler_bot can you create an event: "Aequor - FedRAMP sandbox walkthrough" for 11:00 PT and add Aequor_CISO + infra@aequor.com.
cs_scheduler_bot: Creating event... ✅ Invite created: https://cal.redwood.com/event/aequor-fedramp-1743141592 (11:00 PT / 18:00 UTC). Reminders set.
Olivia: Draft agenda (short):
```
11:00 - 11:05 Goals & pre-reqs (Olivia)
11:05 - 11:25 Live sandbox demo: hosted flow + isolation notes (Chen)
11:25 - 11:40 Compliance Q&A: FedRAMP controls, KMS, residency (Izzy)
11:40 - 11:45 Action items & ownership (Riley)
```
Mateo: I'll upload scrub snapshot to the event doc by 10:25: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/aequor-snap-1743141592. PII removed.
Olivia: Need one owner for post-call follow-ups and to capture any renewal signals. Riley?
Riley: I can own follow-ups, tag AE, and add a "renewal-risk" flag if they ask about on-prem timelines or long-term SLAs.
Chen: I'll record and clip the demo. Also add a slide that summarizes Dedicated vs Hosted isolation guarantees.
Izzy: I'll prepare a 1-pager FedRAMP checklist to paste in chat during the call.
Olivia: Also run a quick 2-question pulse after the call: (1) Did this unblock your compliance question? (Y/N) (2) Confidence to proceed (1-5). Add the score to account health doc.
Mateo: Snapshot uploaded and linked in event doc. cs_scheduler_bot: please resend invites.
cs_scheduler_bot: Event updated by Mateo. Invites resent. Reminder scheduled: 30m before.
Aequor_CISO: (external) Thanks for the fast turnaround. 11:00 PT is confirmed from our side. Please include a short pre-read.
Olivia: Pre-read shared: https://internal.redwood/docs/aequor-fedramp-pre-read.
Chen: Pre-call 10:30 quick sync scheduled (DM). Izzy, Mateo, Riley joining.
Izzy: On standby 10:15-10:35 for any last-minute checks.
Riley: After the call I'll create follow-up ticket(s) and mark any timeline or on-prem asks as "high" priority for AE engagement.
Olivia: Thanks team. See you at 10:30 pre-call. :thumbsup:
